> Elliot will outline the exact queueing transitions.

Sam / Lauren — quick technical note below; attached is a short engineer-readable file (queueing-behavior-notes.md) that you can drop into the appendix. High level:

1) Reserved pool model
- Each Dedicated reservation maps to a guaranteed pool with a configured baseline throughput (baseline_tokens_per_sec). Baseline is derived from reserved GPU count and SKU.
- Baseline guarantees are enforced at the pool level; unrelated customer requests never consume baseline capacity.

2) Burst windows
- Pools may accept burst traffic beyond baseline from the same tenant for short windows (burst_duration) up to an upper bound (burst_tokens_cap) if idle capacity exists. Burst is not a firm SLA; it is a controlled best-effort that we can document in the appendix as "bounded burst behavior".

3) Queueing & priority
- When pool saturation occurs, requests are queued in a priority FIFO with weighted slots: 1) active baseline requests, 2) canary/cold-starts, 3) burst requests. If queue depth exceeds threshold, pre-configured fallback policies apply (model-variant downgrade or redirect to a warm standby variant).

4) Observability hooks
- We support a streaming webhook that emits: pool_id, timestamp, queue_depth, active_runners, baseline_utilization_pct, p50_latency_ms, p99_latency_ms. Sample payload in the attached. TTL for metrics is configurable.

Suggested appendix wording (short):
- Guaranteed baseline: Redwood guarantees baseline throughput for reserved pool <pool_id> equals X tokens/sec per GPU (table to be filled per SKU).
- Bounded burst: Redwood may accept short-term bursts beyond baseline up to burst_tokens_cap when surplus capacity is available; bursts are not guaranteed and may be preempted during sustained contention.
- Queueing: Redwood will prioritize baseline traffic; during chronic saturation Redwood will apply fallback policies listed in Section 3.2.
- Monitoring: Redwood will provide a webhook and a dashboard with queue depth and latency metrics; alerts can be configured to notify Novara.

Let me know the expected baseline throughput you want reserved and I can convert into tokens/sec/table for the SOW.

-Elliot
